related.title: ETSI QKD 金鑰交付：池容量與使用速率
related.titleEn: ETSI QKD key delivery: pool capacity and consumption
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學每回合成功至少0.04；原模型失敗、改善後通過；有記憶時需另建等待與去相干模型。 swap_event_tree.csv、條件成功計數與模型邊界 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.02 與變更 0.045 probability/round、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching minimum0.04 success per round:baseline fails and improvement passes; memory-assisted cases need a separate waiting/decoherence model. swap_event_tree.csv, conditional-success counts and model boundary Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.02 and changed 0.045 probability/round, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學30 s後保留至少5000 bits；800/s通過、1200/s不足；長時間負淨產率仍會耗盡，需限流或擴充。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching reserve after30 s is5000 bits:800/s passes and1200/s fails; sustained negative balance eventually empties the pool and requires throttling or more supply.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成兩鏈路成功率各0.2，交換0.5；改善兩鏈路到0.3，交換固定。 名義式 0.2*0.2*0.5 = 0.02 probability/round；變更式 0.3*0.3*0.5 = 0.045 probability/round。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列兩鏈路四種成功/失敗組合，再僅對雙成功乘交換率；總條件機率守恆且提高單臂不能降低總成功。

合成池10000 bits，產生1000 bits/s、使用800 bits/s，觀察30 s；擾動使用1200 bits/s。 名義式 10000+(1000-800)*30 = 16000 bits；變更式 10000+(1000-1200)*30 = 4000 bits。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐秒更新30次與閉式相符；確認每份已交付key ID不重複使用，且紀錄只有長度、時間與ID雜湊。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic independent link success0.2 each and swapping0.5; improve both links to0.3 with fixed swapping. Nominal 0.2*0.2*0.5 = 0.02 probability/round; changed 0.3*0.3*0.5 = 0.045 probability/round. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate four link-success outcomes, then apply swapping only to joint success; conserve total probability and check monotonicity.

Synthetic pool10000 bits with production1000 bits/s and consumption800 bits/s over30 s; change consumption to1200 bits/s. Nominal 10000+(1000-800)*30 = 16000 bits; changed 10000+(1000-1200)*30 = 4000 bits. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Update one second at a time and compare the closed form; confirm delivered key IDs are not reused and logs contain length, time and ID hashes only.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成兩鏈路成功率各0.2，交換0.5；改善兩鏈路到0.3，交換固定。 名義式 0.2*0.2*0.5 = 0.02 probability/round；變更式 0.3*0.3*0.5 = 0.045 probability/round。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列兩鏈路四種成功/失敗組合，再僅對雙成功乘交換率；總條件機率守恆且提高單臂不能降低總成功。

合成信用−2000 bits、idleSlope20 Mbit/s；擾動信用−6000 bits，斜率不變。 名義式 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us；變更式 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs增加200 bits直到0，獨立求需10或30步；信用不得把byte與bit混為同量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic independent link success0.2 each and swapping0.5; improve both links to0.3 with fixed swapping. Nominal 0.2*0.2*0.5 = 0.02 probability/round; changed 0.3*0.3*0.5 = 0.045 probability/round. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate four link-success outcomes, then apply swapping only to joint success; conserve total probability and check monotonicity.

Synthetic credit−2000 bits withidleSlope20 Mbit/s; change credit to−6000 bits at the same slope. Nominal 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us; changed 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Add200 bits every10 microseconds until zero, requiring10 or30 steps; keep byte and bit credit units distinct.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
